purpose: Final source-based corrections to initial audit inputs. The main gap design and development plan incorporate these corrections; raw audit inputs preserve initial observations, not final implementation authority.

corrections.subject: Classification
corrections.finding: Existing summary, Direct v4, admission, shared child saga, ranking, workspace loss and consult/discussion forms are not remaining functional gaps merely because a same-candidate matrix is missing. Such evidence work belongs under T items.

corrections.subject: Channel retry canonical equivalence
corrections.finding: Consult null and exact-peer audiences, and discussion null and complete-peer audiences, normalize to the same canonical basic draft. Retry equality follows Hub samePostDraft including delivery/causation/correlation/task/trace/priority/ttl; not arbitrary raw JSON spelling. Direct protocol normalization remains its own rule.

corrections.subject: Child commit order
corrections.finding: startDelegatedTask creates requested task; beginTaskDelegation reserves child identity. Parent result admission precedes parent-service receipt, child quiescent/terminal completion, then parent settlement; distinct kill windows must remain distinct.

corrections.subject: Child integration
corrections.finding: Existing assertTaskIntegration requires a completed sourceAttemptId in sourceTask.attemptHistory; child task schema requires empty attemptHistory. Directly naming a child task as integration source is rejected. Child artifact reading exists, but a child-result provenance extension is needed for direct formal integration.

corrections.subject: Bounded Team discovery
corrections.finding: listTeamsPage limits visible output but still lists all stream metadata, sorts ids, and may load many archived Teams. Consumer pagination alone does not establish a total I/O/memory work bound. Current cursor is sorted-array position, not a snapshot-stable sequence.

corrections.subject: Workspace pulse provenance
corrections.finding: Current observation.stage enum has no pulse. Periodic observations require an explicit provenance/stage decision and owning schema/fold/proof/audit updates; do not mislabel them as publish.

corrections.subject: Workflow UI scope
corrections.finding: Existing participant workflow projection UI can be developed independently from optional child-node support. Existing ordinary integration and human review/action forms must not be described as absent.

corrections.subject: Delegation documentation owner
corrections.finding: TeamDelegation is a Consumer class/plugin, not a ctx.teamDelegation service. Documentation must add its package/consumer relationship without inventing a new Context service.

corrections.subject: Publication checks
corrections.finding: Eight standalone publint CLI successes coexist with a repository publication-closure failure for supervisor HTTP protocol chunk. O-06 records the real artifact defect; limited checks do not override it.
